: urate supersaturation ⇢ MSU crystal form & deposition into synovium ⇢ phagocytosis of crystals by macrophages ⇢ activate of proinflammatory cytokines ⇢ neutrophil influx & acute joint inflam
: continued crystal deposition from recurr flares form aggregates of MSU crystals surrounded
by granulomatous inflam (ie, tophi) ⇢ chronic inflam response & progress bone erosion
joint pain, erythema, warmth, swelling, & stiffness
period b/n flares, continued deposition of tophaceous material
: chronic joint pain, swelling, stiffness, &/or deformity;
ex, ears, Achilles tendon, olecranon bursa
» may attenuate overlying skin & appear yellow/white; ulcerations & chalky white d/c
punched-out lytic bone lesions & overhanging sclerotic margins (“rat bite erosions”)
: initiate pharmacotherapy w/ any first-line agent w.in 24h of Sx onset
